algorithm.budget: If3^K>2000000, if no floor-compliant assignment exists, if identity/class contradictions exist, or any source hash differs, stop; no heuristic fallback, split-seed retry, pool expansion or floor weakening.
algorithm.input: Freeze370 E-eligible object IDs and full473-universe constraint union first. Count each physical object once. Retain17 original overlap components, aliases, derivatives and exact-content edges transitively before projecting eligibility; excluded bridges remain constraints.
algorithm.name: Exact coupled-unit enumeration plus convex singleton apportionment
algorithm.objective_exact: Minimize sum over all four classes and three roles of (role_object_count/class_object_total - requested_fraction_role)^2 using rational arithmetic. Equal class weighting; no image quality, appearance, model result, FOV or metadata feature enters this objective.
algorithm.reference_implementation: split_algorithm_reference.py; only synthetic cases executed in this phase.
algorithm.step1: Order coupled units by SHA256 Dataset-v2F|seed|coupled|unit_id, then unit_id. Order role branches by SHA256 Dataset-v2F|seed|role|role_name, then train/validation/test index. Enumerate3^K assignments, no seed search.
algorithm.step2: For each coupled assignment and each class, set singleton lower bounds max(0,floor_role-coupled_class_count_role). If their sum exceeds remaining singleton count, assignment infeasible. Otherwise repeatedly allocate one singleton count to role with smallest exact rational marginal squared-target-error2*(allocated-target_residual)+1. Equal marginal costs favor train, then validation, then test.
algorithm.step3: Choose first globally minimal feasible coupled assignment in the fixed seeded enumeration order. Within each class order singleton units by SHA256 Dataset-v2F|seed|singleton|class|unit_id then unit_id. Allocate first n_train to train, next n_validation to validation, remainder test.
algorithm.step4: Every eligible observation and derivative inherits its physical object and complete component role. All noneligible members retain that grouping constraint without becoming observations. Inactive units remain outside the primary pool.

class_stratification: Object counts, not FITS-image counts; retain cross-class groups as whole indivisible assignment units. Quality evidence tiers and frozen subtypes reported, never re-ranked to balance after outcomes.
fraction_scope_note: Recovering different historical v1 settings is not adoption. No active v2 fractions, floors or seed are inferred from audit/randomization/training seeds.

future_statistical_unit.bootstrap_prospective: 10000 paired replicates, seed2026102305,95percentile intervals; same resampled components for every compared frozen model/seed. Conditional on frozen checkpoints; training-seed uncertainty is not fully represented. No bootstrap or model metrics run now.
future_statistical_unit.dependence: Report370 physical-object units and358 active assignment/dependence units. For sample-uncertainty bootstrap, resample complete active dependence components and retain all object records/multiplicities; compute metrics with one weight per object, not one vote per FITS or equal-weight component averages.
future_statistical_unit.multiple_observations_if_ever_authorized: Primary score uses one deterministic canonical observation per object, lexicographic frozen source path then ID; all other views remain same role and auxiliary. Current370 have one three-band bundle each.
future_statistical_unit.observation: Physical astronomical object; three bands jointly define one observation. No band, preview, derivative or augmentation inflates n.

nominal_target_note: Count arithmetic only, not an allocation, split-feasibility certificate or membership proposal. Exact role counts can differ when optimizing indivisible groups.
